Alyftrek (vanzacaftor/tezacaftor/deutivacaftor) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-589214  
Guideline Name 
Alyftrek (vanzacaftor/tezacaftor/deutivacaftor)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
5/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Alyftrek  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting a diagnosis of cystic 
fibrosis (CF)  


--- PDF page 87 ---
Page 87 
 
AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or laboratory results confirming the 
presence of at least one mutation in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator 
(CFTR) gene  
 
AND 
 
3 - One of the following:  
 
 3.1 CFTR mutation is responsive based on clinical or in vitro data  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 CFTR mutation results in the production of CFTR protein  
 
AND 
 
4 - Patient is 6 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
5 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a specialist affiliated with a CF care center  
 
AND 
 
6 - One of the following:  
 
 6.1 Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting history of 
failure or inadequate response to Trikafta (elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor)  
 
OR 
 
 6.2 Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) demonstrating that patient has a 


--- PDF page 88 ---
Page 88 
documented CFTR gene mutation that is responsive to Alyftrek but is not responsive to 
Trikafta (a complete up to date list of responsive mutations can be referenced in the Trikafta 
Prescribing Information)  
 
Product Name:Alyftrek  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting that patient demonstrates 
demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy (e.g., stable or improved lung function 
[percent predicted forced expiratory volume in one second {PPFEV1}], decreased number of 
pulmonary exacerbations)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a specialist affiliated with a CF care center  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes  
4/30/2026  
Updated dx confirmation criterion due to expanded indication. Updat
ed embedded step through Trikafta (step bypass for pts with Alyftrek-
only mutations)
